create_voxelized_pointcloud: create a VoxelizedPointcloud with a given voxel size and optional 3D bounds
add_points_to_voxel_grid: add points with features, RGB colors, and weights to the voxel grid
get_voxel_indices: get the voxel index for each point in a point cloud tensor
reduce_pointcloud: pool position, feature, weight, and RGB values within each voxel using mean, max, or sum
scatter_weights_to_3d_grid: scatter point weights into a 3D voxel grid tensor of specified dimensions
